definitions.gloss: standing room; standing section; standing-room-only area
definitions.explanation: A section in a theater, concert venue, or stadium where audience members stand rather than sit. Often the cheapest ticket option.

examples.japanese: {座席|ざせき}は{売|う}り{切|き}れだが{立|た}ち{見席|みせき}ならまだある。
examples.english: The seated tickets are sold out, but there's still standing room available.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{見席|みせき}のチケットは{安|やす}いけど、{長時間|ちょうじかん}{立|た}っているのは{疲|つか}れる。
examples.english: Standing room tickets are cheap, but standing for a long time is tiring.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}の{公演|こうえん}だったので、{立|た}ち{見席|みせき}まで{満員|まんいん}だった。
examples.english: It was such a popular performance that even the standing section was packed.

notes:
A designated area in a venue where the audience stands rather than sits. Typically the cheapest ticket option.

FORMS:
{立|た}ち{見|み} (standing viewing) + {席|せき} (seat/section). The shorter form {立|た}ち{見|み} is also commonly used with the same meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立|た}ち{見席|みせき}のチケット: standing room ticket
- {立|た}ち{見席|みせき}で{観|み}る: to watch from the standing section
- {立|た}ち{見席|みせき}まで{満員|まんいん}: standing room is full too

CULTURAL NOTE:
In sumo, {立|た}ち{見席|みせき} tickets are a well-known feature of sold-out tournaments, sold on the day at low prices. At live concerts, standing areas are often called スタンディング.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指定席|していせき}: reserved seat
- {自由席|じゆうせき}: unreserved seat
